world.bio: I am a postdoc in quantum optics from Leipzig, two years into a contract at a university in Hefei. I work on single-photon sources in a basement lab with excellent equipment and no windows. Mornings I run along the Dongpu reservoir at six, evenings I order food by pointing at pictures. My Mandarin is stuck at survival level.
skills_assets: PhD in physics (Leipzig), experience with single-photon detection and cryogenic optical setups
Contract with the university until summer 2027, monthly salary 26,000 RMB
A running routine: 5 am to 6 am along the Dongpu reservoir, currently training for the Hefei marathon in November
A folder of move-in photos on my phone and a printed Chinese lease
A WeChat account with 80 contacts, including colleagues and a few landlords

projects.name: Single-photon source characterization
projects.text: Main experiment of the year. We have a new quantum dot sample that behaves strangely at 4 kelvin, with blinking that should not be there. Three nights this week I stayed in the lab until 10 pm. The paper draft has a figure missing. My supervisor says submit by end of November.

projects.name: Deposit dispute
projects.text: I moved out of my apartment in Shushan district in September. The landlord is keeping my 6,000 RMB deposit, claiming 'wall damage.' The marks on the wall were there when I moved in, and I took photos on day one. The lease is in Chinese only and I cannot tell what clause 7 actually says. The landlord's messages are in Chinese too. I posted about it on a foreigners' group on WeChat to see if anyone had similar experience.

notes.text: Ran 18 km along the reservoir this morning. Legs felt fine, but around km 15 a dog started barking and followed me for a minute. Marathon is on November 8. My target is under 3:45.

Tried to cook Anhui stinky mandarin fish from a recipe I found online. The fish smelled so bad my neighbour knocked on the door. I explained in my broken Mandarin that it was supposed to smell. She looked at me with an expression I can only describe as pity.

Anna called from Berlin. She has an interview at a research institute in Munich. If she gets it, she will move to Munich, not here. We both know it. We did not say it out loud. Talked for an hour about her cat.

Moved into the new apartment on Tuesday. Landlord of the old place sent a message in Chinese. Used a translator: 'wall damage, deposit not returned.' I wrote back: 'The marks were there before I moved in. I have photos.' He replied with a thumbs up, which I am not sure means yes or no.

Looked at the lease. Clause 7 seems to be about 'restoration of the property.' The machine translation says something about 'normal wear' and 'compensation.' Unclear if it includes walls. I do not want to sign anything or accept anything I do not understand.

Lab meeting: professor asked whether I would stay on for a third year. I said I would think about it. Honestly I like Hefei, the food, the running, the silence in the lab. But Anna is not here, and that matters.

The WeChat group had many comments on my deposit story. Someone said 'happens to everyone.' Someone else said 'go to court.' Someone offered a lawyer's number but she only speaks Mandarin. I need someone who can read the contract and speak English.
Slept badly. Dreamed that I was running the marathon but every kilometre marker said '押金.' Woke up laughing, then not laughing.
National Day holiday. Took the high-speed train to Nanjing for two days. Walked on the city wall. Ate duck blood soup, which I liked. Missed Anna more than usual.

messages.text:
Anna: Did you run today?
Me: 18 km.
Anna: You are insane.
Me: It's good for the head.

Landlord: 墙壁有损坏，押金不退。
Me: (translated) The wall marks were there when I moved in. I have photos.
Landlord: 👍
Me: Does this mean you will return it?
Landlord: (no reply)

Wu: Lukas, you look tired.
Me: Deposit trouble.
Wu: Ah. This is common. I can ask my cousin.
Me: Thank you, but I need a lawyer who reads English.

Prof. Chen: Please send me the draft by the 15th.
Me: Will do.
Prof. Chen: Do you need more time?
Me: A few days, maybe.

Mum: Are you still not eating enough vegetables?
Me: I am eating many.
Mum: Send a photo.
Me: Mum.

calendar.event: Send paper draft to Prof. Chen
Anna's interview in Munich (video call after)

relations.about: Girlfriend in Berlin, works as a neuroscientist. We have been together four years. She is deciding whether to move.
Colleague, helpful, patient with my Mandarin.
My supervisor, fair, quiet, does not like excuses.

constraints: Daytime only for lab work, available after 6 pm and weekends
Does not want to spend more than 2,000 RMB on legal help
sensitive: Relationship with Anna might not survive long distance
The deposit is almost a month of rent and it stings
Uncertain about staying in China for a third year
